semiconductor_relevance: High — Eltech Engineers Pvt Ltd provides essential equipment for semiconductor surface treatment and static control, which are critical for manufacturing processes.
summary: Eltech Engineers Pvt Ltd specializes in advanced plasma and corona treatment technologies, ozone generation, and static control solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products enhance surface cleaning, activation, and adhesion, ensuring high-quality manufacturing standards.
capabilities: Atmospheric and vacuum plasma systems for surface cleaning and activation
High-concentration ozone generators for eco-friendly oxidation
Static eliminators and chargers for sensitive manufacturing environments

regional_presence.India: Eltech Engineers Pvt Ltd designs and manufactures all systems in India, supporting the 'Make in India' initiative for semiconductors.
